entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I ordered something a few weeks ago, and I think I need to send it back. I'm a bit overwhelmed with the website. It was a jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a preference, I guess? I think I ordered the wrong size. The jersey is just too tight in the shoulders. I was hoping I could do an exchange, but the return page was so confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. It's no problem at all. Let me just pull up your account and our policy. I see the order was delivered 28 days ago. One moment.
Oh, is that too long? I'm so sorry, I've been so busy.
Not at all! You are well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely get that exchange started for you right now. What size did you need instead?
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I'd need a Large, please.

Perfect. I've just processed that for you. I'm also emailing you a prepaid return label for the medium jersey that was too tight. And since you're one of our VIP members and there was some confusion with the sizing chart, I've upgraded the shipping on your new jersey to complimentary 2-day express. You should have it shortly.
Wow, really? That's amazing. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so easy.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for your VeloFit gear?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
